We need to fix compilation errors. Issues: imports for JUnit4 vs JUnit5. The test uses @BeforeEach, @Test from JUnit5, but also imports JUnit4's @Before and org.junit.Test. The project likely uses JUnit4. Simpler: change to JUnit4 annotations: use @Before for setup, @Test from org.junit.Test, remove JUnit5 imports and @ExtendWith. Also remove MockitoExtension import. Use Mockito static mock method; need import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock; Also need import org.junit.Before; Already there is @Before but also a method setUp with @Before; there is also a method setupBeforeEach with @BeforeEach which we will replace with @Before. Remove duplicate setup. We'll keep one setup method using @Before to create mocks. Also need to import org.junit.Before (already). Remove @BeforeEach annotation and method name. Also adjust NumericIndicator.of expects Indicator<Num>. mockDelegate is Indicator<Num>. Use mock(Indicator.class) returns raw type; need cast: mock(Indicator.class) as Indicator<Num>. Use generic: mock(Indicator.class) returns Indicator, but assign to Indicator<Num>. Use @SuppressWarnings. Or better create mock with generic: mock(Indicator.class) cannot capture generic. Use (Indicator<Num>) mock(Indicator.class). Also need import org.mockito.Mockito.* static.

Also the chain call: NumericIndicator.of(mockDelegate).sma( // comment ) 5).abs(); The code currently broken with comments inside method call. Need to write correctly: NumericIndicator numeric = NumericIndicator.of(mockDelegate).sma(5).abs(); Also need import for NumericIndicator? Already same package.

Also there is duplicate @Before method setUp that sets mockDelegate = new DummyIndicator(); but earlier we set mocks. That conflicts. We can remove the second @Before method or rename. Simpler: remove the second @Before method and keep the mock setup with Mockito.

But we need DummyIndicator maybe not used; can keep but not needed. Remove second method.

Also need import for org.junit.Assert.assertEquals already.

Add import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;

Remove unused imports: org.junit.jupiter.* and MockitoExtension.

Now code.
